execution_environment: ChatGPT web-enabled research plus GitHub connector
additional_initial_reconnaissance_querie: not counted because exact query strings were not retained after conversation-context compaction; their evidence was used only where source identity remained verifiable
database_result_count_reason: The web interface did not expose reproducible database-level result counts; no counts were invented.
token_count_reason: Provider-reported per-role/per-search token telemetry was not exposed in this environment; no token estimates were invented.
cost_reason: No provider billing telemetry or reliable per-call token counts were exposed.
wall_time_reason: No reliable run-level wall-time telemetry exposed.

failed_calls.effect: No scientific data lost; structured files were assembled directly through GitHub after the helper execution reset.
One congress.gov retrieval path was blocked, but alternate indexed Congress/NIH records were returned in the same search and used.

coverage_limits: Purposive historical evidence map rather than exhaustive systematic history of all medical disease reclassification
Web-accessible evidence and predominantly English-language sources
Residual Western/high-income-country representation despite China and West Africa examples
No quantitative historical GDP, national research-expenditure, or war-intensity covariate model in v0.1
Context attribution is qualitative and directness-labelled rather than assigned unsupported causal percentages
reproducibility_note: All final criteria and contextual controls are versioned in the frozen framework. Future historical additions must create a new framework version rather than modifying v0.1 silently.
